ayahs.ar: الٓرٰࣞ تِلۡكَ اٰيٰتُ الۡكِتٰبِ الۡمُبِيۡنِࣞ‏
ayahs.tl: Alif-Laaam-Raa; tilka Aayaatul Kitaabil Mubeen
ayahs.en: Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the verses of the clear Book.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا٘ اَنۡزَلۡنٰهُ قُرۡءٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Innaaa anzalnaahu quraanan 'Arabiyyal la 'allakum ta'qiloon
ayahs.en: Indeed, We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur'an that you might understand.

ayahs.ar: نَحۡنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيۡكَ اَحۡسَنَ الۡقَصَصِ بِمَا٘ اَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡكَ هٰذَا الۡقُرۡاٰنَࣗۖ وَاِنۡ كُنۡتَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهٖ لَمِنَ الۡغٰفِلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Nahnu naqussu 'alaika ahsanal qasasi bimaaa awhainaaa ilaika haazal quraana wa in kunta min qablihee laminal ghaafileen
ayahs.en: We relate to you, [O Muhammad], the best of stories in what We have revealed to you of this Qur'an although you were, before it, among the unaware.

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ يُوۡسُفُ لِاَبِيۡهِ يٰ٘اَبَتِ اِنِّيۡ رَاَيۡتُ اَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوۡكَبًا وَّالشَّمۡسَ وَالۡقَمَرَ رَاَيۡتُهُمۡ لِيۡ سٰجِدِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Iz qaala Yoosufu li abeehi yaaa abati innee ra aytu ahada 'ashara kawkabanw wash shamsa walqamara ra aytuhum lee saajideen
ayahs.en: [Of these stories mention] when Joseph said to his father, "O my father, indeed I have seen [in a dream] eleven stars and the sun and the moon; I saw them prostrating to me."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يٰبُنَيَّ لَا تَقۡصُصۡ رُءۡيَاكَ عَلٰ٘ي اِخۡوَتِكَ فَيَكِيۡدُوۡا لَكَ كَيۡدًاؕ اِنَّ الشَّيۡطٰنَ لِلۡاِنۡسَانِ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِيۡنٌ
ayahs.tl: Qaala yaa bunaiya laa taqsus ru'yaaka 'alaaa ikhwatika fayakeedoo laka kaidaa; innash Shaitaana lil insaani 'aduwwum mubeen
ayahs.en: He said, "O my son, do not relate your vision to your brothers or they will contrive against you a plan. Indeed Satan, to man, is a manifest enemy.

ayahs.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ يَجۡتَبِيۡكَ رَبُّكَ وَيُعَلِّمُكَ مِنۡ تَاۡوِيۡلِ الۡاَحَادِيۡثِ وَيُتِمُّ نِعۡمَتَهٗ عَلَيۡكَ وَعَلٰ٘ي اٰلِ يَعۡقُوۡبَ كَمَا٘ اَتَمَّهَا عَلٰ٘ي اَبَوَيۡكَ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ وَاِسۡحٰقَؕ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ عَلِيۡمٌ حَكِيۡمٌࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa kazaalika yajtabeeka rabbuka wa yu'allimuka min taaweelil ahaadeesi wa yutimmu ni'matahoo 'alaika wa 'alaaa Aali Ya'qooba kamaaa atammahaa 'alaaa abawaika min qablu Ibraaheema wa Ishaaq; inna Rabbaka 'Aleemun hakeem
ayahs.en: And thus will your Lord choose you and teach you the interpretation of narratives and complete His favor upon you and upon the family of Jacob, as He completed it upon your fathers before, Abraham and Isaac. Indeed, your Lord is Knowing and Wise."

ayahs.ar: لَقَدۡ كَانَ فِيۡ يُوۡسُفَ وَاِخۡوَتِهٖ٘ اٰيٰتٌ لِّلسَّآئِلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Laqad kaana fee Yoosufa wa ikhwatiheee Aayaatul lissaaa'ileen
ayahs.en: Certainly were there in Joseph and his brothers signs for those who ask,

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ قَالُوۡا لَيُوۡسُفُ وَاَخُوۡهُ اَحَبُّ اِلٰ٘ي اَبِيۡنَا مِنَّا وَنَحۡنُ عُصۡبَةٌؕ اِنَّ اَبَانَا لَفِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنِۙۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Iz qaaloo la Yoosufu wa akhoohu ahabbu ilaaa Abeenaa minnaa wa nahnu 'usbah; inna abaanaa lafee dalaalim mubeen
ayahs.en: When they said, "Joseph and his brother are more beloved to our father than we, while we are a clan. Indeed, our father is in clear error.

ayahs.ar: اِۨقۡتُلُوۡا يُوۡسُفَ اَوِ اطۡرَحُوۡهُ اَرۡضًا يَّخۡلُ لَكُمۡ وَجۡهُ اَبِيۡكُمۡ وَتَكُوۡنُوۡا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهٖ قَوۡمًا صٰلِحِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Uqtuloo Yoosufa awitra hoohu ardany yakhlu lakum wajhu abeekum wa takoonoo mim ba'dihee qawman saaliheen
ayahs.en: Kill Joseph or cast him out to [another] land; the countenance of your father will [then] be only for you, and you will be after that a righteous people."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ قَآئِلٌ مِّنۡهُمۡ لَا تَقۡتُلُوۡا يُوۡسُفَ وَاَلۡقُوۡهُ فِيۡ غَيٰبَتِ الۡجُبِّ يَلۡتَقِطۡهُ بَعۡضُ السَّيَّارَةِ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ فٰعِلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaalaa qaaa'ilum minhum laa taqtuloo Yoosufa wa alqoohu fee ghayaabatil jubbi yaltaqithu badus sai yaarati in kuntum faa 'ileen
ayahs.en: Said a speaker among them, "Do not kill Joseph but throw him into the bottom of the well; some travelers will pick him up - if you would do [something]."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰ٘اَبَانَا مَا لَكَ لَا تَاۡمَنَّا عَلٰي يُوۡسُفَ وَاِنَّا لَهٗ لَنٰصِحُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo yaaa abaanaa maa laka laa taamannaa 'alaa Yoosufa wa innaa lahoo lanaa sihoon
ayahs.en: They said, "O our father, why do you not entrust us with Joseph while indeed, we are to him sincere counselors?

ayahs.ar: اَرۡسِلۡهُ مَعَنَا غَدًا يَّرۡتَعۡ وَيَلۡعَبۡ وَاِنَّا لَهٗ لَحٰفِظُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Arilhu ma'anaa ghadany yarta'wa yal'ab wa innaa lahoo lahaafizoon
ayahs.en: Send him with us tomorrow that he may eat well and play. And indeed, we will be his guardians.

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اِنِّيۡ لَيَحۡزُنُنِيۡ٘ اَنۡ تَذۡهَبُوۡا بِهٖ وَاَخَافُ اَنۡ يَّاۡكُلَهُ الذِّئۡبُ وَاَنۡتُمۡ عَنۡهُ غٰفِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala innee la yahzununeee an tazhaboo bihee wa akhaafu anyyaakulahuz zi'bu wa antum 'anhu ghaafiloon
ayahs.en: [Jacob] said, "Indeed, it saddens me that you should take him, and I fear that a wolf would eat him while you are of him unaware."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا لَئِنۡ اَكَلَهُ الذِّئۡبُ وَنَحۡنُ عُصۡبَةٌ اِنَّا٘ اِذًا لَّخٰسِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo la in akalahuzzi'bu wa nahnu 'usbatun innaaa izal lakhaasiroon
ayahs.en: They said, "If a wolf should eat him while we are a [strong] clan, indeed, we would then be losers."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبُوۡا بِهٖ وَاَجۡمَعُوۡ٘ا اَنۡ يَّجۡعَلُوۡهُ فِيۡ غَيٰبَتِ الۡجُبِّۚ وَاَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡهِ لَتُنَبِّئَنَّهُمۡ بِاَمۡرِهِمۡ هٰذَا وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falammaa zahaboo bihee wa ajma'ooo anyyaj'aloohu fee ghayaabatil jubb; wa awyainaaa ilaihi latunabbi 'annahum bi amrihim haaza wa hum laa yash'uroon
ayahs.en: So when they took him [out] and agreed to put him into the bottom of the well... But We inspired to him, "You will surely inform them [someday] about this affair of theirs while they do not perceive [your identity]."

ayahs.ar: وَجَآءُوۡ٘ اَبَاهُمۡ عِشَآءً يَّبۡكُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa jaaa'ooo abaahum 'ishaaa 'any yabkoon
ayahs.en: And they came to their father at night, weeping.

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰ٘اَبَانَا٘ اِنَّا ذَهَبۡنَا نَسۡتَبِقُ وَتَرَكۡنَا يُوۡسُفَ عِنۡدَ مَتَاعِنَا فَاَكَلَهُ الذِّئۡبُۚ وَمَا٘ اَنۡتَ بِمُؤۡمِنٍ لَّنَا وَلَوۡ كُنَّا صٰدِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo yaaa abaanaaa innaa zahabnaa nastabiqu wa taraknaa Yoosufa 'inda mataa'inaa fa akhalahuz zi'b, wa maaa anta bimu'minil lanaa wa law kunnaa saadiqeen
ayahs.en: They said, "O our father, indeed we went racing each other and left Joseph with our possessions, and a wolf ate him. But you would not believe us, even if we were truthful."

ayahs.ar: وَجَآءُوۡ عَلٰي قَمِيۡصِهٖ بِدَمٍ كَذِبٍؕ قَالَ بَلۡ سَوَّلَتۡ لَكُمۡ اَنۡفُسُكُمۡ اَمۡرًاؕ فَصَبۡرٌ جَمِيۡلٌؕ وَاللّٰهُ الۡمُسۡتَعَانُ عَلٰي مَا تَصِفُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa jaaa'oo 'alaa qamee shihee bidamin kazi' qaala bal sawwalat lakum anfusukum amraa; fasabrun jameel; wallaahul musta'aanu 'alaa man tasifoon
ayahs.en: And they brought upon his shirt false blood. [Jacob] said, "Rather, your souls have enticed you to something, so patience is most fitting. And Allah is the one sought for help against that which you describe."

ayahs.ar: وَجَآءَتۡ سَيَّارَةٌ فَاَرۡسَلُوۡا وَارِدَهُمۡ فَاَدۡلٰي دَلۡوَهٗؕ قَالَ يٰبُشۡرٰي هٰذَا غُلٰمٌؕ وَاَسَرُّوۡهُ بِضَاعَةًؕ وَاللّٰهُ عَلِيۡمٌۭ بِمَا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa jaaa'at saiyaaratun fa-arsaloo waaridahum fa adlaa dalwah; qaala yaa bushraa haaza ghulaam; wa asarroohu bi-daa'ah; wallaahu 'aleemum bimaa ya'maloon
ayahs.en: And there came a company of travelers; then they sent their water drawer, and he let down his bucket. He said, "Good news! Here is a boy." And they concealed him, [taking him] as merchandise; and Allah was knowing of what they did.

ayahs.ar: وَشَرَوۡهُ بِثَمَنٍۭ بَخۡسٍ دَرَاهِمَ مَعۡدُوۡدَةٍۚ وَكَانُوۡا فِيۡهِ مِنَ الزَّاهِدِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa sharawhu bisamanim bakhsin daraahima ma'doo datinw wa kaanoo feehi minaz zaahideen
ayahs.en: And they sold him for a reduced price - a few dirhams - and they were, concerning him, of those content with little.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِي اشۡتَرٰىهُ مِنۡ مِّصۡرَ لِامۡرَاَتِهٖ٘ اَكۡرِمِيۡ مَثۡوٰىهُ عَسٰ٘ي اَنۡ يَّنۡفَعَنَا٘ اَوۡ نَتَّخِذَهٗ وَلَدًاؕ وَكَذٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوۡسُفَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِؗ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهٗ مِنۡ تَاۡوِيۡلِ الۡاَحَادِيۡثِؕ وَاللّٰهُ غَالِبٌ عَلٰ٘ي اَمۡرِهٖ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalal lazish taraahu mim Misra limra atiheee akrimee maswaahu 'asaaa any-yanfa'anaaa aw nattakhizahoo waladaa; wa kazaalika mak-kannaa li-Yoosufa fil ardi wa linu'allimahoo min taaweelil ahaadees; wallaahu ghaalibun 'alaaa amrihee wa laakinna aksaran naasi laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: And the one from Egypt who bought him said to his wife, "Make his residence comfortable. Perhaps he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son." And thus, We established Joseph in the land that We might teach him the interpretation of events. And Allah is predominant over His affair, but most of the people do not know.

ayahs.ar: وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ اَشُدَّهٗ٘ اٰتَيۡنٰهُ حُكۡمًا وَّعِلۡمًاؕ وَكَذٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي الۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa lammaa balagha ashuddahooo aatainaahu bukmanw wa 'ilmaa; wa kazaa lika najzil muhsineen
ayahs.en: And when Joseph reached maturity, We gave him judgment and knowledge. And thus We reward the doers of good.

ayahs.ar: وَرَاوَدَتۡهُ الَّتِيۡ هُوَ فِيۡ بَيۡتِهَا عَنۡ نَّفۡسِهٖ وَغَلَّقَتِ الۡاَبۡوَابَ وَقَالَتۡ هَيۡتَ لَكَؕ قَالَ مَعَاذَ اللّٰهِ اِنَّهٗ رَبِّيۡ٘ اَحۡسَنَ مَثۡوَايَؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا يُفۡلِحُ الظّٰلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa raawadat hul latee huwa fee baitihaa 'an nafsihee wa ghallaqatil abwaaba wa qaalat haita lak; qaala ma'aazal laahi innahoo rabbeee ahsana maswaay; innahoo laa yuflihuz-zaalimoon
ayahs.en: And she, in whose house he was, sought to seduce him. She closed the doors and said, "Come, you." He said, "[I seek] the refuge of Allah. Indeed, he is my master, who has made good my residence. Indeed, wrongdoers will not succeed."

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ هَمَّتۡ بِهٖ وَهَمَّ بِهَاۚ لَوۡلَا٘ اَنۡ رَّاٰ بُرۡهَانَ رَبِّهٖؕ كَذٰلِكَ لِنَصۡرِفَ عَنۡهُ السُّوۡٓءَ وَالۡفَحۡشَآءَؕ اِنَّهٗ مِنۡ عِبَادِنَا الۡمُخۡلَصِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad hammat bihee wa hamma bihaa law laaa ar ra-aa burhaana rabbih;; kazaalika linasrifa 'anhu sooo'a walfa hshaaa'; innahoo min 'ibaadi nal mukhlaseen
ayahs.en: And she certainly determined [to seduce] him, and he would have inclined to her had he not seen the proof of his Lord. And thus [it was] that We should avert from him evil and immorality. Indeed, he was of Our chosen servants.

ayahs.ar: وَاسۡتَبَقَا الۡبَابَ وَقَدَّتۡ قَمِيۡصَهٗ مِنۡ دُبُرٍ وَّاَلۡفَيَا سَيِّدَهَا لَدَا الۡبَابِؕ قَالَتۡ مَا جَزَآءُ مَنۡ اَرَادَ بِاَهۡلِكَ سُوۡٓءًا اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ يُّسۡجَنَ اَوۡ عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wastabaqal baaba wa qaddat qameesahoo min dubu rinw wa alfayaa saiyidahaa ladal baab; qaalat maa jazaaa'u man araada bi ahlika sooo'an illaaa any-yusjana aw azaabun aleem
ayahs.en: And they both raced to the door, and she tore his shirt from the back, and they found her husband at the door. She said, "What is the recompense of one who intended evil for your wife but that he be imprisoned or a painful punishment?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ هِيَ رَاوَدَتۡنِيۡ عَنۡ نَّفۡسِيۡ وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌ مِّنۡ اَهۡلِهَاۚ اِنۡ كَانَ قَمِيۡصُهٗ قُدَّ مِنۡ قُبُلٍ فَصَدَقَتۡ وَهُوَ مِنَ الۡكٰذِبِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala hiya raawadatnee 'an nafsee wa shahida shaahidum min ahlihaa in kaana qameesuhoo qudda min qubulin fasadaqat wa huwa minal kaazibeen
ayahs.en: [Joseph] said, "It was she who sought to seduce me." And a witness from her family testified. "If his shirt is torn from the front, then she has told the truth, and he is of the liars.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنۡ كَانَ قَمِيۡصُهٗ قُدَّ مِنۡ دُبُرٍ فَكَذَبَتۡ وَهُوَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa in kaana qameesuhoo qudda min duburin fakazabat wa huwa minas saadiqeen
ayahs.en: But if his shirt is torn from the back, then she has lied, and he is of the truthful."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا رَاٰ قَمِيۡصَهٗ قُدَّ مِنۡ دُبُرٍ قَالَ اِنَّهٗ مِنۡ كَيۡدِكُنَّؕ اِنَّ كَيۡدَكُنَّ عَظِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Falammaa ra-aa qamee sahoo qudda min duburin qaala innahoo min kaidikunna inna kaidakunna 'azeem
ayahs.en: So when her husband saw his shirt torn from the back, he said, "Indeed, it is of the women's plan. Indeed, your plan is great.

ayahs.ar: يُوۡسُفُ اَعۡرِضۡ عَنۡ هٰذَاࣝ وَاسۡتَغۡفِرِيۡ لِذَنۭۡ بِكِۚۖ اِنَّكِ كُنۡتِ مِنَ الۡخٰطِـِٕيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Yoosofu a'rid 'an haaza wastaghfiree lizambiki innaki kunti minal khaati'een
ayahs.en: Joseph, ignore this. And, [my wife], ask forgiveness for your sin. Indeed, you were of the sinful."

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ نِسۡوَةٌ فِي الۡمَدِيۡنَةِ امۡرَاَتُ الۡعَزِيۡزِ تُرَاوِدُ فَتٰىهَا عَنۡ نَّفۡسِهٖۚ قَدۡ شَغَفَهَا حُبًّاؕ اِنَّا لَنَرٰىهَا فِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaala niswatun filma deenatim ra atul'Azeezi turaawidu fataahaa 'an nafsihee qad shaghafahaa bubbaa; innaa lana raahaa fee dalaalim mubeen
ayahs.en: And women in the city said, "The wife of al-'Azeez is seeking to seduce her slave boy; he has impassioned her with love. Indeed, we see her [to be] in clear error."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا سَمِعَتۡ بِمَكۡرِهِنَّ اَرۡسَلَتۡ اِلَيۡهِنَّ وَاَعۡتَدَتۡ لَهُنَّ مُتَّكَاً وَّاٰتَتۡ كُلَّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِّنۡهُنَّ سِكِّيۡنًا وَّقَالَتِ اخۡرُجۡ عَلَيۡهِنَّۚ فَلَمَّا رَاَيۡنَهٗ٘ اَكۡبَرۡنَهٗ وَقَطَّعۡنَ اَيۡدِيَهُنَّؗ وَقُلۡنَ حَاشَ لِلّٰهِ مَا هٰذَا بَشَرًاؕ اِنۡ هٰذَا٘ اِلَّا مَلَكٌ كَرِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Falammaa sami'at bimak rihinna arsalat ilaihinna wa a'tadat lahunna muttaka anw wa aatat kulla waahidatim min hunna sikkeenanw wa qaala tikh ruj 'alaihinna falammaa ra aynahooo akbarnahoo wa qatta'na aydiyahunna wa qulna haasha lillaahi maa haaza basharaa; in haazaaa illaa malakun kareem
ayahs.en: So when she heard of their scheming, she sent for them and prepared for them a banquet and gave each one of them a knife and said [to Joseph], "Come out before them." And when they saw him, they greatly admired him and cut their hands and said, "Perfect is Allah! This is not a man; this is none but a noble angel."

ayahs.ar: قَالَتۡ فَذٰلِكُنَّ الَّذِيۡ لُمۡتُنَّنِيۡ فِيۡهِؕ وَلَقَدۡ رَاوَدۡتُّهٗ عَنۡ نَّفۡسِهٖ فَاسۡتَعۡصَمَؕ وَلَئِنۡ لَّمۡ يَفۡعَلۡ مَا٘ اٰمُرُهٗ لَيُسۡجَنَنَّ وَلَيَكُوۡنًا مِّنَ الصّٰغِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaalat fazaalikunnal lazee lumtunnanee feeh; wa laqad raawattuhoo 'an nafsihee fasta'sam; wa la'il lam yaf'al maaa aamuruhoo la yusjananna wa la yakoonam minas saaghireen
ayahs.en: She said, "That is the one about whom you blamed me. And I certainly sought to seduce him, but he firmly refused; and if he will not do what I order him, he will surely be imprisoned and will be of those debased."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ السِّجۡنُ اَحَبُّ اِلَيَّ مِمَّا يَدۡعُوۡنَنِيۡ٘ اِلَيۡهِۚ وَاِلَّا تَصۡرِفۡ عَنِّيۡ كَيۡدَهُنَّ اَصۡبُ اِلَيۡهِنَّ وَاَكُنۡ مِّنَ الۡجٰهِلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala rabbis sijnu ahabbu ilaiya mimma yad'oo naneee 'ilaihi wa illaa tasrif 'annee kaidahunna asbu ilaihinna wa akum minal jaahileen
ayahs.en: He said, "My Lord, prison is more to my liking than that to which they invite me. And if You do not avert from me their plan, I might incline toward them and [thus] be of the ignorant."

ayahs.ar: فَاسۡتَجَابَ لَهٗ رَبُّهٗ فَصَرَفَ عَنۡهُ كَيۡدَهُنَّؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ السَّمِيۡعُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Fastajaaba lahoo rabbuhoo fasarafa 'anhu kaidahunn; innahoo Huswas_Samee'ul 'Aleem
ayahs.en: So his Lord responded to him and averted from him their plan. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ بَدَا لَهُمۡ مِّنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا رَاَوُا الۡاٰيٰتِ لَيَسۡجُنُنَّهٗ حَتّٰي حِيۡنٍࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Summa badaa lahum mim ba'di maa ra-awul Aayaati layasjununnahoo hatta heen
ayahs.en: Then it appeared to them after they had seen the signs that al-'Azeez should surely imprison him for a time.

ayahs.ar: وَدَخَلَ مَعَهُ السِّجۡنَ فَتَيٰنِؕ قَالَ اَحَدُهُمَا٘ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَرٰىنِيۡ٘ اَعۡصِرُ خَمۡرًاۚ وَقَالَ الۡاٰخَرُ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَرٰىنِيۡ٘ اَحۡمِلُ فَوۡقَ رَاۡسِيۡ خُبۡزًا تَاۡكُلُ الطَّيۡرُ مِنۡهُؕ نَبِّئۡنَا بِتَاۡوِيۡلِهٖۚ اِنَّا نَرٰىكَ مِنَ الۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa dakhala ma'ahussijna fata yaan; qaala ahaduhumaaa inneee araaneee a'siru khamranw wa qaalal aakharu inneee khubzan taakulut tairu minh; nabbi 'naa bitaaweelihee innaa naraaka minal muhsineen
ayahs.en: And there entered the prison with him two young men. One of them said, "Indeed, I have seen myself [in a dream] pressing wine." The other said, "Indeed, I have seen myself carrying upon my head [some] bread, from which the birds were eating. Inform us of its interpretation; indeed, we see you to be of those who do good."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَا يَاۡتِيۡكُمَا طَعَامٌ تُرۡزَقٰنِهٖ٘ اِلَّا نَبَّاۡتُكُمَا بِتَاۡوِيۡلِهٖ قَبۡلَ اَنۡ يَّاۡتِيَكُمَاؕ ذٰلِكُمَا مِمَّا عَلَّمَنِيۡ رَبِّيۡؕ اِنِّيۡ تَرَكۡتُ مِلَّةَ قَوۡمٍ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِاللّٰهِ وَهُمۡ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِ هُمۡ كٰفِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala laa yaateekumaa ta'aamun turzaqaaniheee illaa nabbaatukumaa bitaaweelihee qabla any yaatiyakumaa; zaali kumaa mimmaa 'allamanee rabbee; innee taraktu millata qawmil laa yu'minoona billaahi wahum bil aakhirati hum kaafiroon
ayahs.en: He said, "You will not receive food that is provided to you except that I will inform you of its interpretation before it comes to you. That is from what my Lord has taught me. Indeed, I have left the religion of a people who do not believe in Allah, and they, in the Hereafter, are disbelievers.

ayahs.ar: وَاتَّبَعۡتُ مِلَّةَ اٰبَآءِيۡ٘ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ وَاِسۡحٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوۡبَؕ مَا كَانَ لَنَا٘ اَنۡ نُّشۡرِكَ بِاللّٰهِ مِنۡ شَيۡءٍؕ ذٰلِكَ مِنۡ فَضۡلِ اللّٰهِ عَلَيۡنَا وَعَلَي النَّاسِ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَشۡكُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wattab'tu millata aabaaa'eee Ibraaheema wa Ishaaqa wa Ya'qoob; maa kaana lanaaa an nushrika billaahi min shai' zaalikamin fadlil laahi 'alainaa wa 'alan naasi wa laakinna aksaran naasi laa yashkuroon
ayahs.en: And I have followed the religion of my fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. And it was not for us to associate anything with Allah. That is from the favor of Allah upon us and upon the people, but most of the people are not grateful.

ayahs.ar: يٰصَاحِبَيِ السِّجۡنِ ءَاَرۡبَابٌ مُّتَفَرِّقُوۡنَ خَيۡرٌ اَمِ اللّٰهُ الۡوَاحِدُ الۡقَهَّارُؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Yaa saahibayis sijni 'a-arbaabum mutafarriqoona khayrun amil laahul waahidul qahhaar
ayahs.en: O [my] two companions of prison, are separate lords better or Allah, the One, the Prevailing?

ayahs.ar: مَا تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ٘ اِلَّا٘ اَسۡمَآءً سَمَّيۡتُمُوۡهَا٘ اَنۡتُمۡ وَاٰبَآؤُكُمۡ مَّا٘ اَنۡزَلَ اللّٰهُ بِهَا مِنۡ سُلۡطٰنٍؕ اِنِ الۡحُكۡمُ اِلَّا لِلّٰهِؕ اَمَرَ اَلَّا تَعۡبُدُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا٘ اِيَّاهُؕ ذٰلِكَ الدِّيۡنُ الۡقَيِّمُ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Maa ta'budoona min doonihee illaaa asmaaa'an sam maitumoohaaa antum wa aabaaa'ukum maaa anzalal laahu bihaa min sultan; inilhukmu illaa lillaah; amara allaa ta'budooo illaaa iyyaah; zaalikad deenul qaiyimu wa laakinna aksaran naasi laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: You worship not besides Him except [mere] names you have named them, you and your fathers, for which Allah has sent down no authority. Legislation is not but for Allah. He has commanded that you worship not except Him. That is the correct religion, but most of the people do not know.

ayahs.ar: يٰصَاحِبَيِ السِّجۡنِ اَمَّا٘ اَحَدُكُمَا فَيَسۡقِيۡ رَبَّهٗ خَمۡرًاۚ وَاَمَّا الۡاٰخَرُ فَيُصۡلَبُ فَتَاۡكُلُ الطَّيۡرُ مِنۡ رَّاۡسِهٖؕ قُضِيَ الۡاَمۡرُ الَّذِيۡ فِيۡهِ تَسۡتَفۡتِيٰنِؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Yaa saahibayis sijni ammaaa ahadukumaa fa yasqee rabbahoo khamranw wa ammal aakharu fa yuslabu fataakulut tairu mir raasih; qudiyal amrul lazee feehi tastaftiyaan
ayahs.en: O two companions of prison, as for one of you, he will give drink to his master of wine; but as for the other, he will be crucified, and the birds will eat from his head. The matter has been decreed about which you both inquire."

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ لِلَّذِيۡ ظَنَّ اَنَّهٗ نَاجٍ مِّنۡهُمَا اذۡكُرۡنِيۡ عِنۡدَ رَبِّكَؗ فَاَنۡسٰىهُ الشَّيۡطٰنُ ذِكۡرَ رَبِّهٖ فَلَبِثَ فِي السِّجۡنِ بِضۡعَ سِنِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qaala lillazee zanna annahoo najim minhumaz kurnee 'inda rabbika fa-ansaahush Shaitaanu zikra Rabbihee falabisa fis sijni bad'a sineen
ayahs.en: And he said to the one whom he knew would go free, "Mention me before your master." But Satan made him forget the mention [to] his master, and Joseph remained in prison several years.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ الۡمَلِكُ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَرٰي سَبۡعَ بَقَرٰتٍ سِمَانٍ يَّاۡكُلُهُنَّ سَبۡعٌ عِجَافٌ وَّسَبۡعَ سُنۭۡ بُلٰتٍ خُضۡرٍ وَّاُخَرَ يٰبِسٰتٍؕ يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الۡمَلَاُ اَفۡتُوۡنِيۡ فِيۡ رُءۡيَايَ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ لِلرُّءۡيَا تَعۡبُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalal maliku inneee araa sab'a baqaraatin simaaniny yaakuluhunna sab'un 'ijaafunw wa sab'a sumbulaatinkhudrinw wa ukhara yaabisaat; yaaa ayuhal mala-u aftoonee fee nu'yaaya in kuntum lirru'yaa ta'buroon
ayahs.en: And [subsequently] the king said, "Indeed, I have seen [in a dream] seven fat cows being eaten by seven [that were] lean, and seven green spikes [of grain] and others [that were] dry. O eminent ones, explain to me my vision, if you should interpret visions."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اَضۡغَاثُ اَحۡلَامٍۚ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِتَاۡوِيۡلِ الۡاَحۡلَامِ بِعٰلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaalooo adghaasu ahlaa minw wa maa nahnu bitaaweelil ahlaami bi'aalimeen
ayahs.en: They said, "[It is but] a mixture of false dreams, and we are not learned in the interpretation of dreams."

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡ نَجَا مِنۡهُمَا وَادَّكَرَ بَعۡدَ اُمَّةٍ اَنَا اُنَبِّئُكُمۡ بِتَاۡوِيۡلِهٖ فَاَرۡسِلُوۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalal lazee najaa minhumaa waddakara ba'da ummatin ana unabbi'ukum bitalweelihee fa-arsiloon
ayahs.en: But the one who was freed and remembered after a time said, "I will inform you of its interpretation, so send me forth."

ayahs.ar: يُوۡسُفُ اَيُّهَا الصِّدِّيۡقُ اَفۡتِنَا فِيۡ سَبۡعِ بَقَرٰتٍ سِمَانٍ يَّاۡكُلُهُنَّ سَبۡعٌ عِجَافٌ وَّسَبۡعِ سُنۭۡ بُلٰتٍ خُضۡرٍ وَّاُخَرَ يٰبِسٰتٍۙ لَّعَلِّيۡ٘ اَرۡجِعُ اِلَي النَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yoosufu ayyuhas siddee qu aftinaa fee sab'i baqaraatin simaaniny yaakuluhunna sab'un 'ijaafunw wa sabi'i sumbulaatin khudrinw wa ukhara yaabisaatil la'alleee arj'u ilan naasi la'allahum ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: [He said], "Joseph, O man of truth, explain to us about seven fat cows eaten by seven [that were] lean, and seven green spikes [of grain] and others [that were] dry - that I may return to the people; perhaps they will know [about you]."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ تَزۡرَعُوۡنَ سَبۡعَ سِنِيۡنَ دَاَبًاۚ فَمَا حَصَدۡتُّمۡ فَذَرُوۡهُ فِيۡ سُنۭۡ بُلِهٖ٘ اِلَّا قَلِيۡلًا مِّمَّا تَاۡكُلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala tazra'oona sab'a sineena da aban famaa basattum fazaroohu fee sumbu liheee illaa qaleelam mimmaa taakuloon
ayahs.en: [Joseph] said, "You will plant for seven years consecutively; and what you harvest leave in its spikes, except a little from which you will eat.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ يَاۡتِيۡ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ ذٰلِكَ سَبۡعٌ شِدَادٌ يَّاۡكُلۡنَ مَا قَدَّمۡتُمۡ لَهُنَّ اِلَّا قَلِيۡلًا مِّمَّا تُحۡصِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Summa yaatee mim ba'di zaalika sab'un shidaaduny yaa kulna maa qaddamtum lahunna illaa qaleelam mimma tuhsinoon
ayahs.en: Then will come after that seven difficult [years] which will consume what you saved for them, except a little from which you will store.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ يَاۡتِيۡ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ ذٰلِكَ عَامٌ فِيۡهِ يُغَاثُ النَّاسُ وَفِيۡهِ يَعۡصِرُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Summa yadtee mim ba'di zaalika 'aamun feehi yughaa sun naasu wa feehi ya'siroon
ayahs.en: Then will come after that a year in which the people will be given rain and in which they will press [olives and grapes]."

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ الۡمَلِكُ ائۡتُوۡنِيۡ بِهٖۚ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُ الرَّسُوۡلُ قَالَ ارۡجِعۡ اِلٰي رَبِّكَ فَسۡـَٔلۡهُ مَا بَالُ النِّسۡوَةِ الّٰتِيۡ قَطَّعۡنَ اَيۡدِيَهُنَّؕ اِنَّ رَبِّيۡ بِكَيۡدِهِنَّ عَلِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalal maliku'toonee bihee falammaa jaaa'ahur rasoolu qaalar-ji ilaa rabbika fas'alhu maa baalun niswatil laatee qatta'na aydiyahunn; inna Rabbee bikaidihinna 'Aleem
ayahs.en: And the king said, "Bring him to me." But when the messenger came to him, [Joseph] said, "Return to your master and ask him what is the case of the women who cut their hands. Indeed, my Lord is Knowing of their plan."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ مَا خَطۡبُكُنَّ اِذۡ رَاوَدۡتُّنَّ يُوۡسُفَ عَنۡ نَّفۡسِهٖؕ قُلۡنَ حَاشَ لِلّٰهِ مَا عَلِمۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ سُوۡٓءٍؕ قَالَتِ امۡرَاَتُ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡـٰٔنَ حَصۡحَصَ الۡحَقُّؗ اَنَا رَاوَدۡتُّهٗ عَنۡ نَّفۡسِهٖ وَاِنَّهٗ لَمِنَ الصّٰدِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala maa khatbukunna iz raawattunna Yoosufa 'annafsih; qulna haasha lillaahi maa 'alimnaa 'alaihi min sooo'; qaalatim ra atul 'Azeezil 'aana hashasal haqq, ana raawat tuhoo 'an nafsihee wa innahoo laminas saadiqeen
ayahs.en: Said [the king to the women], "What was your condition when you sought to seduce Joseph?" They said, "Perfect is Allah! We know about him no evil." The wife of al-'Azeez said, "Now the truth has become evident. It was I who sought to seduce him, and indeed, he is of the truthful.

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكَ لِيَعۡلَمَ اَنِّيۡ لَمۡ اَخُنۡهُ بِالۡغَيۡبِ وَاَنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَهۡدِيۡ كَيۡدَ الۡخَآئِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Zaalika liya'lama annee lam akhunhu bilghaibi wa annal laaha laa yahdee kaidal khaaa'ineen
ayahs.en: That is so al-'Azeez will know that I did not betray him in [his] absence and that Allah does not guide the plan of betrayers.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا٘ اُبَرِّئُ نَفۡسِيۡۚ اِنَّ النَّفۡسَ لَاَمَّارَةٌۭ بِالسُّوۡٓءِ اِلَّا مَا رَحِمَ رَبِّيۡؕ اِنَّ رَبِّيۡ غَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa ubarri'u nafsee; innan nafsa la ammaaratum bissooo'i illaa maa rahima Rabbee; inna Rabbee Ghafoorur Raheem
ayahs.en: And I do not acquit myself. Indeed, the soul is a persistent enjoiner of evil, except those upon which my Lord has mercy. Indeed, my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful."

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ الۡمَلِكُ ائۡتُوۡنِيۡ بِهٖ٘ اَسۡتَخۡلِصۡهُ لِنَفۡسِيۡۚ فَلَمَّا كَلَّمَهٗ قَالَ اِنَّكَ الۡيَوۡمَ لَدَيۡنَا مَكِيۡنٌ اَمِيۡنٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalal maliku' toonee biheee astakhlishu linafsee falammaa kallamahoo qaala innakal yawma ladainaa makeenun ameen
ayahs.en: And the king said, "Bring him to me; I will appoint him exclusively for myself." And when he spoke to him, he said, "Indeed, you are today established [in position] and trusted."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اجۡعَلۡنِيۡ عَلٰي خَزَآئِنِ الۡاَرۡضِۚ اِنِّيۡ حَفِيۡظٌ عَلِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Qaalaj 'alnee 'alaa khazaaa'inil ardi innee hafeezun 'aleem
ayahs.en: [Joseph] said, "Appoint me over the storehouses of the land. Indeed, I will be a knowing guardian."

ayahs.ar: وَكَذٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوۡسُفَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِۚ يَتَبَوَّاُ مِنۡهَا حَيۡثُ يَشَآءُؕ نُصِيۡبُ بِرَحۡمَتِنَا مَنۡ نَّشَآءُ وَلَا نُضِيۡعُ اَجۡرَ الۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa kazaalika makkannaa li Yoosufa fil ardi yatabawwa'u minhaa haisu yashaaaa'; nuseebu birahmatinaa man nashaaa'u wa laa nudee'u ajral muhsineen
ayahs.en: And thus We established Joseph in the land to settle therein wherever he willed. We touch with Our mercy whom We will, and We do not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good.

ayahs.ar: وَلَاَجۡرُ الۡاٰخِرَةِ خَيۡرٌ لِّلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَكَانُوۡا يَتَّقُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa la ajrul Aakhirati khairul lillazeena aamanoo wa kaanoo yattaqoon
ayahs.en: And the reward of the Hereafter is better for those who believed and were fearing Allah.

ayahs.ar: وَجَآءَ اِخۡوَةُ يُوۡسُفَ فَدَخَلُوۡا عَلَيۡهِ فَعَرَفَهُمۡ وَهُمۡ لَهٗ مُنۡكِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa jaaa'a ikhwatu Yoosufa fadakhaloo 'alaihi fa'arafahum wa hum lahoo munkiroon
ayahs.en: And the brothers of Joseph came [seeking food], and they entered upon him; and he recognized them, but he was to them unknown.

ayahs.ar: وَلَمَّا جَهَّزَهُمۡ بِجَهَازِهِمۡ قَالَ ائۡتُوۡنِيۡ بِاَخٍ لَّكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَبِيۡكُمۡۚ اَلَا تَرَوۡنَ اَنِّيۡ٘ اُوۡفِي الۡكَيۡلَ وَاَنَا خَيۡرُ الۡمُنۡزِلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa lammaa jahhazahum bijahaazihim qaala' toonee bi akhil lakum min abeekum; alaa tarawna anneee oofil kaila wa ana khairul munzileen
ayahs.en: And when he had furnished them with their supplies, he said, "Bring me a brother of yours from your father. Do not you see that I give full measure and that I am the best of accommodators?

ayahs.ar: فَاِنۡ لَّمۡ تَاۡتُوۡنِيۡ بِهٖ فَلَا كَيۡلَ لَكُمۡ عِنۡدِيۡ وَلَا تَقۡرَبُوۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Fa il lam taatoonee bihee falaa kaila lakum 'indee wa laa taqraboon
ayahs.en: But if you do not bring him to me, no measure will there be [hereafter] for you from me, nor will you approach me."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا سَنُرَاوِدُ عَنۡهُ اَبَاهُ وَاِنَّا لَفٰعِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo sanuraawidu 'anhu abaahu wa innaa lafaa'iloon
ayahs.en: They said, "We will attempt to dissuade his father from [keeping] him, and indeed, we will do [it]."

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ لِفِتۡيٰنِهِ اجۡعَلُوۡا بِضَاعَتَهُمۡ فِيۡ رِحَالِهِمۡ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَعۡرِفُوۡنَهَا٘ اِذَا انۡقَلَبُوۡ٘ا اِلٰ٘ي اَهۡلِهِمۡ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaala lifityaanihij 'aloo bidaa'atahum fee rihaalihim la'allahum ya'rifoonahaaa izan qalabooo ilaaa ahlihim la'allahum yarji'oon
ayahs.en: And [Joseph] said to his servants, "Put their merchandise into their saddlebags so they might recognize it when they have gone back to their people that perhaps they will [again] return."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا رَجَعُوۡ٘ا اِلٰ٘ي اَبِيۡهِمۡ قَالُوۡا يٰ٘اَبَانَا مُنِعَ مِنَّا الۡكَيۡلُ فَاَرۡسِلۡ مَعَنَا٘ اَخَانَا نَكۡتَلۡ وَاِنَّا لَهٗ لَحٰفِظُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falammaa raja'ooo ilaaa abeehim qaaloo yaaa abaanaa muni'a minnal kailu fa arsil ma'anaaa akhaanaa naktal wa innaa lahoo lahaafizoon
ayahs.en: So when they returned to their father, they said, "O our father, [further] measure has been denied to us, so send with us our brother [that] we will be given measure. And indeed, we will be his guardians."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ هَلۡ اٰمَنُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ اِلَّا كَمَا٘ اَمِنۡتُكُمۡ عَلٰ٘ي اَخِيۡهِ مِنۡ قَبۡلُؕ فَاللّٰهُ خَيۡرٌ حٰفِظًاࣕ وَّهُوَ اَرۡحَمُ الرّٰحِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala hal aamanukum 'alihi illaa kamaa amintukum 'alaaa akheehimin qabl; fal laahu khairun haafizanw wa Huwa arhamur Raahimeen
ayahs.en: He said, "Should I entrust you with him except [under coercion] as I entrusted you with his brother before? But Allah is the best guardian, and He is the most merciful of the merciful."

ayahs.ar: وَلَمَّا فَتَحُوۡا مَتَاعَهُمۡ وَجَدُوۡا بِضَاعَتَهُمۡ رُدَّتۡ اِلَيۡهِمۡؕ قَالُوۡا يٰ٘اَبَانَا مَا نَبۡغِيۡؕ هٰذِهٖ بِضَاعَتُنَا رُدَّتۡ اِلَيۡنَاۚ وَنَمِيۡرُ اَهۡلَنَا وَنَحۡفَظُ اَخَانَا وَنَزۡدَادُ كَيۡلَ بَعِيۡرٍؕ ذٰلِكَ كَيۡلٌ يَّسِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa lammaa fatahoo mataa 'ahum wajadoo bidaa'atahum ruddat ilaihim qaaloo yaaa abaanaa maa nabghee; haazihee bida 'atunaa ruddat ilainaa wa nameeru ahlanaa wa nahfazu akhaanaa wa nazdaadu kaila ba'eer; zaalika kailuny yaseer
ayahs.en: And when they opened their baggage, they found their merchandise returned to them. They said, "O our father, what [more] could we desire? This is our merchandise returned to us. And we will obtain supplies for our family and protect our brother and obtain an increase of a camel's load; that is an easy measurement."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَنۡ اُرۡسِلَهٗ مَعَكُمۡ حَتّٰي تُؤۡتُوۡنِ مَوۡثِقًا مِّنَ اللّٰهِ لَتَاۡتُنَّنِيۡ بِهٖ٘ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ يُّحَاطَ بِكُمۡۚ فَلَمَّا٘ اٰتَوۡهُ مَوۡثِقَهُمۡ قَالَ اللّٰهُ عَلٰي مَا نَقُوۡلُ وَكِيۡلٌ
ayahs.tl: Qaala lan ursilahoo ma'akum hattaa tu'tooni mawsiqam minal laahis lataa tunnanee biheee illaaa nay yuhaata bikum falammaaa aatawhu mawsiqahum qaalal laahu 'alaa maa naqoolu Wakeel
ayahs.en: [Jacob] said, "Never will I send him with you until you give me a promise by Allah that you will bring him [back] to me, unless you should be surrounded by enemies." And when they had given their promise, he said, "Allah, over what we say, is Witness."

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ يٰبَنِيَّ لَا تَدۡخُلُوۡا مِنۭۡ بَابٍ وَّاحِدٍ وَّادۡخُلُوۡا مِنۡ اَبۡوَابٍ مُّتَفَرِّقَةٍؕ وَمَا٘ اُغۡنِيۡ عَنۡكُمۡ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ مِنۡ شَيۡءٍؕ اِنِ الۡحُكۡمُ اِلَّا لِلّٰهِؕ عَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡتُۚ وَعَلَيۡهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ الۡمُتَوَكِّلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaala yaa baniyya laa tadkhuloo mim baabinw waa hidinw wadkhuloo min abwaabim mutafarriqah; wa maaa ughnee 'ankum minal laahi min shai'in; inil hukmu illaa lillaahi 'alaihi tawakkaltu wa 'alaihi fal yatawakkalil Mutawakkiloon
ayahs.en: And he said, "O my sons, do not enter from one gate but enter from different gates; and I cannot avail you against [the decree of] Allah at all. The decision is only for Allah; upon Him I have relied, and upon Him let those who would rely [indeed] rely."

ayahs.ar: وَلَمَّا دَخَلُوۡا مِنۡ حَيۡثُ اَمَرَهُمۡ اَبُوۡهُمۡؕ مَا كَانَ يُغۡنِيۡ عَنۡهُمۡ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ مِنۡ شَيۡءٍ اِلَّا حَاجَةً فِيۡ نَفۡسِ يَعۡقُوۡبَ قَضٰىهَاؕ وَاِنَّهٗ لَذُوۡ عِلۡمٍ لِّمَا عَلَّمۡنٰهُ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa lammaa dakhaloo min haisu amarahum aboohum maa kaana yughnee 'anhum minal laahi min shai'in illaa haajatan fee nafsi Ya'qooba qadaahaa; wa innahoo lazoo 'ilmil limaa 'allamnaahu wa laakinna aksaran naasi laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: And when they entered from where their father had ordered them, it did not avail them against Allah at all except [it was] a need within the soul of Jacob, which he satisfied. And indeed, he was a possessor of knowledge because of what We had taught him, but most of the people do not know.

ayahs.ar: وَلَمَّا دَخَلُوۡا عَلٰي يُوۡسُفَ اٰوٰ٘ي اِلَيۡهِ اَخَاهُ قَالَ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَنَا اَخُوۡكَ فَلَا تَبۡتَئِسۡ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa lammaa dakhaloo 'alaa Yoosufa aawaaa ilaihi akhaahu qaala inneee ana akhooka falaa tabta'is bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon
ayahs.en: And when they entered upon Joseph, he took his brother to himself; he said, "Indeed, I am your brother, so do not despair over what they used to do [to me]."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا جَهَّزَهُمۡ بِجَهَازِهِمۡ جَعَلَ السِّقَايَةَ فِيۡ رَحۡلِ اَخِيۡهِ ثُمَّ اَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنٌ اَيَّتُهَا الۡعِيۡرُ اِنَّكُمۡ لَسٰرِقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falammaa jahhazahum bijahaazihim ja'alas siqaayata fee rahli akheehi summa azzana mu'azzinun ayyatuhal'eeru innakum lasaariqoon
ayahs.en: So when he had furnished them with their supplies, he put the [gold measuring] bowl into the bag of his brother. Then an announcer called out, "O caravan, indeed you are thieves."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا وَاَقۡبَلُوۡا عَلَيۡهِمۡ مَّاذَا تَفۡقِدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo wa aqbaloo 'alaihim maazaa tafqidoon
ayahs.en: They said while approaching them, "What is it you are missing?"

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا نَفۡقِدُ صُوَاعَ الۡمَلِكِ وَلِمَنۡ جَآءَ بِهٖ حِمۡلُ بَعِيۡرٍ وَّاَنَا بِهٖ زَعِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo nafqidu suwaa'al maliki wa liman jaaa'a bihee himlu ba'eerinw wa ana bihee za'eem
ayahs.en: They said, "We are missing the measure of the king. And for he who produces it is [the reward of] a camel's load, and I am responsible for it."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا تَاللّٰهِ لَقَدۡ عَلِمۡتُمۡ مَّا جِئۡنَا لِنُفۡسِدَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا كُنَّا سٰرِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo tallaahi laqad 'alimtum maa ji'na linufsida fil ardi wa maa kunnaa saariqeen
ayahs.en: They said, "By Allah, you have certainly known that we did not come to cause corruption in the land, and we have not been thieves."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا فَمَا جَزَآؤُهٗ٘ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ كٰذِبِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo famaa jazaaa'u hooo in kuntum kaazibeen
ayahs.en: The accusers said, "Then what would be its recompense if you should be liars?"

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا جَزَآؤُهٗ مَنۡ وُّجِدَ فِيۡ رَحۡلِهٖ فَهُوَ جَزَآؤُهٗؕ كَذٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo jazaaa'uhoo manw wujida fee rahlihee fahuwa jazaaa'uh; kazaalika najziz zaalimeen
ayahs.en: [The brothers] said, "Its recompense is that he in whose bag it is found - he [himself] will be its recompense. Thus do we recompense the wrongdoers."

ayahs.ar: فَبَدَاَ بِاَوۡعِيَتِهِمۡ قَبۡلَ وِعَآءِ اَخِيۡهِ ثُمَّ اسۡتَخۡرَجَهَا مِنۡ وِّعَآءِ اَخِيۡهِؕ كَذٰلِكَ كِدۡنَا لِيُوۡسُفَؕ مَا كَانَ لِيَاۡخُذَ اَخَاهُ فِيۡ دِيۡنِ الۡمَلِكِ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ يَّشَآءَ اللّٰهُؕ نَرۡفَعُ دَرَجٰتٍ مَّنۡ نَّشَآءُؕ وَفَوۡقَ كُلِّ ذِيۡ عِلۡمٍ عَلِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Fabada-a bi-aw'iyatihim qabla wi'aaa'i akheehi summas takhrajahaa minw wi 'aaa'i akheeh; kazaalika kidnaa li Yoosuf; maa kaana liyaakhuza akhaahu fee deenil maliki illaaa any yashaaa'al laah; narfa'u darajaatim man nashaaa'; wa fawqa kulli zee 'ilmin 'Aleem
ayahs.en: So he began [the search] with their bags before the bag of his brother; then he extracted it from the bag of his brother. Thus did We plan for Joseph. He could not have taken his brother within the religion of the king except that Allah willed. We raise in degrees whom We will, but over every possessor of knowledge is one [more] knowing.

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنۡ يَّسۡرِقۡ فَقَدۡ سَرَقَ اَخٌ لَّهٗ مِنۡ قَبۡلُۚ فَاَسَرَّهَا يُوۡسُفُ فِيۡ نَفۡسِهٖ وَلَمۡ يُبۡدِهَا لَهُمۡۚ قَالَ اَنۡتُمۡ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًاۚ وَاللّٰهُ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَا تَصِفُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo iny yasriq faqad saraqa akhul lahoo min qabl; fa asarrahaa Yoosufu fee nafsihee wa lam yubdihaa lahum; qaala antum sharrum makaananw wallaahu a'lamu bimaa tasifoon
ayahs.en: They said, "If he steals - a brother of his has stolen before." But Joseph kept it within himself and did not reveal it to them. He said, "You are worse in position, and Allah is most knowing of what you describe."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الۡعَزِيۡزُ اِنَّ لَهٗ٘ اَبًا شَيۡخًا كَبِيۡرًا فَخُذۡ اَحَدَنَا مَكَانَهٗۚ اِنَّا نَرٰىكَ مِنَ الۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo yaaa ayyuhal 'Azeezu inna lahooo aban shaikhan kabeeran fakhuz ahadanaa makaanahoo innaa naraaka minal muhsineen
ayahs.en: They said, "O 'Azeez, indeed he has a father [who is] an old man, so take one of us in place of him. Indeed, we see you as a doer of good."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ مَعَاذَ اللّٰهِ اَنۡ نَّاۡخُذَ اِلَّا مَنۡ وَّجَدۡنَا مَتَاعَنَا عِنۡدَهٗ٘ۙ اِنَّا٘ اِذًا لَّظٰلِمُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala ma'aazal laahi an naakhuza illaa manw wajadnaa mataa'anaa 'indahoo innaaa izal lazaalimoon
ayahs.en: He said, "[I seek] the refuge of Allah [to prevent] that we take except him with whom we found our possession. Indeed, we would then be unjust."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا اسۡتَيۡـَٔسُوۡا مِنۡهُ خَلَصُوۡا نَجِيًّاؕ قَالَ كَبِيۡرُهُمۡ اَلَمۡ تَعۡلَمُوۡ٘ا اَنَّ اَبَاكُمۡ قَدۡ اَخَذَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ مَّوۡثِقًا مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَمِنۡ قَبۡلُ مَا فَرَّطۡتُّمۡ فِيۡ يُوۡسُفَۚ فَلَنۡ اَبۡرَحَ الۡاَرۡضَ حَتّٰي يَاۡذَنَ لِيۡ٘ اَبِيۡ٘ اَوۡ يَحۡكُمَ اللّٰهُ لِيۡۚ وَهُوَ خَيۡرُ الۡحٰكِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falammas tay'asoo minhu khalasoo najiyyan qaala kabeeruhum alam ta'lamoon anna abaakum qad akhaza 'alaikum mawsiqam minal laahi wa min qablu maa farrattum fee Yoosufa falan abrahal arda hattaa yaazana leee abeee aw yahkumal laahu lee wa huwa khairul lhaakimeen
ayahs.en: So when they had despaired of him, they secluded themselves in private consultation. The eldest of them said, "Do you not know that your father has taken upon you an oath by Allah and [that] before you failed in [your duty to] Joseph? So I will never leave [this] land until my father permits me or Allah decides for me, and He is the best of judges.

ayahs.ar: اِرۡجِعُوۡ٘ا اِلٰ٘ي اَبِيۡكُمۡ فَقُوۡلُوۡا يٰ٘اَبَانَا٘ اِنَّ ابۡنَكَ سَرَقَۚ وَمَا شَهِدۡنَا٘ اِلَّا بِمَا عَلِمۡنَا وَمَا كُنَّا لِلۡغَيۡبِ حٰفِظِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Irji'ooo ilaaa abeekum faqooloo yaaa abaanaaa innab naka saraq; wa maa shahidnaaa illaa bimaa 'alimnaa wa maa kunnaa lilghaibi haafizeen
ayahs.en: Return to your father and say, "O our father, indeed your son has stolen, and we did not testify except to what we knew. And we were not witnesses of the unseen,

ayahs.ar: وَسۡـَٔلِ الۡقَرۡيَةَ الَّتِيۡ كُنَّا فِيۡهَا وَالۡعِيۡرَ الَّتِيۡ٘ اَقۡبَلۡنَا فِيۡهَاؕ وَاِنَّا لَصٰدِقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Was'alil qaryatal latee kunnaa feehaa wal'eeral lateee aqbalnaa feehaa wa innaa lasaadiqoon
ayahs.en: And ask the city in which we were and the caravan in which we came - and indeed, we are truthful,"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ بَلۡ سَوَّلَتۡ لَكُمۡ اَنۡفُسُكُمۡ اَمۡرًاؕ فَصَبۡرٌ جَمِيۡلٌؕ عَسَي اللّٰهُ اَنۡ يَّاۡتِيَنِيۡ بِهِمۡ جَمِيۡعًاؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الۡعَلِيۡمُ الۡحَكِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Qaala bal sawwalat lakum anfusukum amran fasabrun jameelun 'asal laahu any yaa tiyanee bihim jamee'aa; innahoo Huwal 'Aleemul Hakeem
ayahs.en: [Jacob] said, "Rather, your souls have enticed you to something, so patience is most fitting. Perhaps Allah will bring them to me all together. Indeed it is He who is the Knowing, the Wise."

ayahs.ar: وَتَوَلّٰي عَنۡهُمۡ وَقَالَ يٰ٘اَسَفٰي عَلٰي يُوۡسُفَ وَابۡيَضَّتۡ عَيۡنٰهُ مِنَ الۡحُزۡنِ فَهُوَ كَظِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa tawallaa 'anhum wa qaala yaaa asafaa 'alaa Yoosufa wabyaddat 'aynaahu minal huzni fahuwa kazeem
ayahs.en: And he turned away from them and said, "Oh, my sorrow over Joseph," and his eyes became white from grief, for he was [of that] a suppressor.

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا تَاللّٰهِ تَفۡتَؤُا تَذۡكُرُ يُوۡسُفَ حَتّٰي تَكُوۡنَ حَرَضًا اَوۡ تَكُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡهٰلِكِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo tallaahi tafta'u tazkuru Yoosufa hattaa takoona haradan aw takoona minal haalikeen
ayahs.en: They said, "By Allah, you will not cease remembering Joseph until you become fatally ill or become of those who perish."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اِنَّمَا٘ اَشۡكُوۡا بَثِّيۡ وَحُزۡنِيۡ٘ اِلَي اللّٰهِ وَاَعۡلَمُ مِنَ اللّٰهِ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala innamaaa ashkoo bassee wa huzneee ilal laahi wa a'lamu minal laahi maa laa ta'lamoon
ayahs.en: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allah, and I know from Allah that which you do not know.

ayahs.ar: يٰبَنِيَّ اذۡهَبُوۡا فَتَحَسَّسُوۡا مِنۡ يُّوۡسُفَ وَاَخِيۡهِ وَلَا تَايۡـَٔسُوۡا مِنۡ رَّوۡحِ اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا يَايۡـَٔسُ مِنۡ رَّوۡحِ اللّٰهِ اِلَّا الۡقَوۡمُ الۡكٰفِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yaa baniyyaz haboo fatahassasoo miny Yoosufa wa akheehi wa laa tai'asoo mir rawhil laahi innahoo laa yai'asu mir rawhil laahi illal qawmul kaafiroon
ayahs.en: O my sons, go and find out about Joseph and his brother and despair not of relief from Allah. Indeed, no one despairs of relief from Allah except the disbelieving people."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوۡا عَلَيۡهِ قَالُوۡا يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الۡعَزِيۡزُ مَسَّنَا وَاَهۡلَنَا الضُّرُّ وَجِئۡنَا بِبِضَاعَةٍ مُّزۡجٰىةٍ فَاَوۡفِ لَنَا الۡكَيۡلَ وَتَصَدَّقۡ عَلَيۡنَاؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَجۡزِي الۡمُتَصَدِّقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falammaa dakhaloo 'alaihi qaaloo yaaa ayyuhal 'Azeezu massanaa wa ahlanad durru wa ji'naa bibidaa 'timmuzjaatin fa awfi lanal kaila wa tasaddaq 'alainaa innal laaha yajzil mutasaddiqeen
ayahs.en: So when they entered upon Joseph, they said, "O 'Azeez, adversity has touched us and our family, and we have come with goods poor in quality, but give us full measure and be charitable to us. Indeed, Allah rewards the charitable."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ هَلۡ عَلِمۡتُمۡ مَّا فَعَلۡتُمۡ بِيُوۡسُفَ وَاَخِيۡهِ اِذۡ اَنۡتُمۡ جٰهِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala hal 'alimtum maa fa'altum bi Yoosufa wa akheehi iz antum jaahiloon
ayahs.en: He said, "Do you know what you did with Joseph and his brother when you were ignorant?"

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا ءَاِنَّكَ لَاَنۡتَ يُوۡسُفُؕ قَالَ اَنَا يُوۡسُفُ وَهٰذَا٘ اَخِيۡؗ قَدۡ مَنَّ اللّٰهُ عَلَيۡنَاؕ اِنَّهٗ مَنۡ يَّتَّقِ وَيَصۡبِرۡ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُضِيۡعُ اَجۡرَ الۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo 'a innaka la anta Yoosufu qaala ana Yoosufu wa haazaaa akhee qad mannal laahu 'alainaa innahoo mai yattaqi wa yasbir fa innal laaha laa yudee'u ajral muhsineen
ayahs.en: They said, "Are you indeed Joseph?" He said "I am Joseph, and this is my brother. Allah has certainly favored us. Indeed, he who fears Allah and is patient, then indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا تَاللّٰهِ لَقَدۡ اٰثَرَكَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيۡنَا وَاِنۡ كُنَّا لَخٰطِـِٕيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo tallaahi laqad aasarakal laahu 'alainaa wa in kunnaa lakhaati'een
ayahs.en: They said, "By Allah, certainly has Allah preferred you over us, and indeed, we have been sinners."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ لَا تَثۡرِيۡبَ عَلَيۡكُمُ الۡيَوۡمَؕ يَغۡفِرُ اللّٰهُ لَكُمۡؗ وَهُوَ اَرۡحَمُ الرّٰحِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala laa tasreeba 'alaikumul yawma yaghfirul laahu lakum wa Huwa arhamur raahimeen
ayahs.en: He said, "No blame will there be upon you today. Allah will forgive you; and He is the most merciful of the merciful."

ayahs.ar: اِذۡهَبُوۡا بِقَمِيۡصِيۡ هٰذَا فَاَلۡقُوۡهُ عَلٰي وَجۡهِ اَبِيۡ يَاۡتِ بَصِيۡرًاۚ وَاۡتُوۡنِيۡ بِاَهۡلِكُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Izhaboo biqameesee haazaa fa alqoohu 'alaa wajhi abee yaati baseeranw waatoonee bi ahlikum ajma'een
ayahs.en: Take this, my shirt, and cast it over the face of my father; he will become seeing. And bring me your family, all together."

ayahs.ar: وَلَمَّا فَصَلَتِ الۡعِيۡرُ قَالَ اَبُوۡهُمۡ اِنِّيۡ لَاَجِدُ رِيۡحَ يُوۡسُفَ لَوۡلَا٘ اَنۡ تُفَنِّدُوۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Wa lammaa fasalatil 'eeru qaala aboohum innee la ajidu reeha Yoosufa law laaa an tufannidoon
ayahs.en: And when the caravan departed [from Egypt], their father said, "Indeed, I find the smell of Joseph [and would say that he was alive] if you did not think me weakened in mind."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا تَاللّٰهِ اِنَّكَ لَفِيۡ ضَلٰلِكَ الۡقَدِيۡمِ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo tallaahi innaka lafee dalaalikal qadeem
ayahs.en: They said, "By Allah, indeed you are in your [same] old error."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا٘ اَنۡ جَآءَ الۡبَشِيۡرُ اَلۡقٰىهُ عَلٰي وَجۡهِهٖ فَارۡتَدَّ بَصِيۡرًاؕۚ قَالَ اَلَمۡ اَقُلۡ لَّكُمۡۚ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَعۡلَمُ مِنَ اللّٰهِ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falammaaa an jaaa'albasheeru alqaahu 'alaa wajhihee fartadda baseeran qaala alam aqul lakum inneee a'lamu minal laahi maa laa ta'lamoon
ayahs.en: And when the bearer of good tidings arrived, he cast it over his face, and he returned [once again] seeing. He said, "Did I not tell you that I know from Allah that which you do not know?"

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰ٘اَبَانَا اسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لَنَا ذُنُوۡبَنَا٘ اِنَّا كُنَّا خٰطِـِٕيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo yaaa abaanas taghfir lanaa zunoo =banaaa innaa kunnaa khaati'een
ayahs.en: They said, "O our father, ask for us forgiveness of our sins; indeed, we have been sinners."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ سَوۡفَ اَسۡتَغۡفِرُ لَكُمۡ رَبِّيۡؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الۡغَفُوۡرُ الرَّحِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Qaala sawfa astaghfiru lakum Rabbeee innahoo Huwal Ghafoorur Raheem
ayahs.en: He said, "I will ask forgiveness for you from my Lord. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوۡا عَلٰي يُوۡسُفَ اٰوٰ٘ي اِلَيۡهِ اَبَوَيۡهِ وَقَالَ ادۡخُلُوۡا مِصۡرَ اِنۡ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ اٰمِنِيۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Falammaa dakhaloo 'alaa Yoosufa aawaaa ilaihi abayaihi wa qaalad khuloo Misra inshaaa'al laahu aamineen
ayahs.en: And when they entered upon Joseph, he took his parents to himself and said, "Enter Egypt, Allah willing, safe [and secure]."

ayahs.ar: وَرَفَعَ اَبَوَيۡهِ عَلَي الۡعَرۡشِ وَخَرُّوۡا لَهٗ سُجَّدًاۚ وَقَالَ يٰ٘اَبَتِ هٰذَا تَاۡوِيۡلُ رُءۡيَايَ مِنۡ قَبۡلُؗ قَدۡ جَعَلَهَا رَبِّيۡ حَقًّاؕ وَقَدۡ اَحۡسَنَ بِيۡ٘ اِذۡ اَخۡرَجَنِيۡ مِنَ السِّجۡنِ وَجَآءَ بِكُمۡ مِّنَ الۡبَدۡوِ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ اَنۡ نَّزَغَ الشَّيۡطٰنُ بَيۡنِيۡ وَبَيۡنَ اِخۡوَتِيۡؕ اِنَّ رَبِّيۡ لَطِيۡفٌ لِّمَا يَشَآءُؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الۡعَلِيۡمُ الۡحَكِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Wa raf'a abawaihi 'alal 'arshi wa kharroo lahoo sujjadaa; wa qaala yaaa abati haaza taaweelu ru'yaaya min qablu qad ja'alahaa Rabbee haqqaa; wa qad ahsana beee iz akhrajanee minas sijni wa jaaa'a bikum minal badwi mim ba'di an nazaghash Shaitaanu bainee wa baina ikhwatee; inna Rabbee lateeful limaa yashaaa'; innahoo Huwal 'Aleemul Hakeem
ayahs.en: And he raised his parents upon the throne, and they bowed to him in prostration. And he said, "O my father, this is the explanation of my vision of before. My Lord has made it reality. And He was certainly good to me when He took me out of prison and brought you [here] from bedouin life after Satan had induced [estrangement] between me and my brothers. Indeed, my Lord is Subtle in what He wills. Indeed, it is He who is the Knowing, the Wise.

ayahs.ar: رَبِّ قَدۡ اٰتَيۡتَنِيۡ مِنَ الۡمُلۡكِ وَعَلَّمۡتَنِيۡ مِنۡ تَاۡوِيۡلِ الۡاَحَادِيۡثِۚ فَاطِرَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِࣞ اَنۡتَ وَلِيّٖ فِي الدُّنۡيَا وَالۡاٰخِرَةِۚ تَوَفَّنِيۡ مُسۡلِمًا وَّاَلۡحِقۡنِيۡ بِالصّٰلِحِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Rabbi qad aataitanee minal mulki wa 'allamtanee min taaweelil ahaadees; faati ras samaawaati wal ardi Anta waliyyee fid dunyaa wal Aakhirati tawaffanee muslimanw wa alhiqnee bissaaliheen
ayahs.en: My Lord, You have given me [something] of sovereignty and taught me of the interpretation of dreams. Creator of the heavens and earth, You are my protector in this world and in the Hereafter. Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous."

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكَ مِنۡ اَنۭۡ بَآءِ الۡغَيۡبِ نُوۡحِيۡهِ اِلَيۡكَۚ وَمَا كُنۡتَ لَدَيۡهِمۡ اِذۡ اَجۡمَعُوۡ٘ا اَمۡرَهُمۡ وَهُمۡ يَمۡكُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Zaalika min ambaaa'il ghaibi nooheehi ilaika wa maa kunta ladaihim iz ajma'ooo amrahum wa hum yamkuroon
ayahs.en: That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal, [O Muhammad], to you. And you were not with them when they put together their plan while they conspired.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا٘ اَكۡثَرُ النَّاسِ وَلَوۡ حَرَصۡتَ بِمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa aksarun naasi wa law harasta bimu'mineen
ayahs.en: And most of the people, although you strive [for it], are not believers.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ اَجۡرٍؕ اِنۡ هُوَ اِلَّا ذِكۡرٌ لِّلۡعٰلَمِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maa tas'aluhum 'alaihi min ajr; in huwa illaa zikrul lil'aalameen
ayahs.en: And you do not ask of them for it any payment. It is not except a reminder to the worlds.

ayahs.ar: وَكَاَيِّنۡ مِّنۡ اٰيَةٍ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ يَمُرُّوۡنَ عَلَيۡهَا وَهُمۡ عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa ka ayyim min Aayatin fis samaawaati wal ardi yamurroona 'alaihaa wa hum 'anhaa mu'ridoon
ayahs.en: And how many a sign within the heavens and earth do they pass over while they, therefrom, are turning away.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يُؤۡمِنُ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ بِاللّٰهِ اِلَّا وَهُمۡ مُّشۡرِكُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa yu'minu aksaru hum billaahi illaa wa hum mushrikoon
ayahs.en: And most of them believe not in Allah except while they associate others with Him.

ayahs.ar: اَفَاَمِنُوۡ٘ا اَنۡ تَاۡتِيَهُمۡ غَاشِيَةٌ مِّنۡ عَذَابِ اللّٰهِ اَوۡ تَاۡتِيَهُمُ السَّاعَةُ بَغۡتَةً وَّهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Afa aminooo an taatiya hum ghaashiyatum min 'azaabil laahi aw taatiyahumus Saa'atu baghtatanw wa hum laa yash'uroon
ayahs.en: Then do they feel secure that there will not come to them an overwhelming [aspect] of the punishment of Allah or that the Hour will not come upon them suddenly while they do not perceive?

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ هٰذِهٖ سَبِيۡلِيۡ٘ اَدۡعُوۡ٘ا اِلَي اللّٰهِࣞؔ عَلٰي بَصِيۡرَةٍ اَنَا وَمَنِ اتَّبَعَنِيۡؕ وَسُبۡحٰنَ اللّٰهِ وَمَا٘ اَنَا مِنَ الۡمُشۡرِكِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul haazihee sabeeleee ad'ooo ilal laah; 'alaa baseera tin ana wa manit taba'anee wa Subhaanal laahi wa maaa ana minal mushrikeen
ayahs.en: Say, "This is my way; I invite to Allah with insight, I and those who follow me. And exalted is Allah; and I am not of those who associate others with Him."

ayahs.ar: وَمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَ اِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوۡحِيۡ٘ اِلَيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ اَهۡلِ الۡقُرٰيؕ اَفَلَمۡ يَسِيۡرُوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ فَيَنۡظُرُوۡا كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡؕ وَلَدَارُ الۡاٰخِرَةِ خَيۡرٌ لِّلَّذِيۡنَ اتَّقَوۡاؕ اَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa arsalnaa min qablika illaa rijaalan nooheee ilaihim min ahlil quraa; afalam yaseeroo fil ardi fa yanzuroo kaifa kaana 'aaqibatul lazeena min qablihim; wa la Daarul Aakhirati Khairul lillazeenat taqaw; afalaa ta'qiloon
ayahs.en: And We sent not before you [as messengers] except men to whom We revealed from among the people of cities. So have they not traveled through the earth and observed how was the end of those before them? And the home of the Hereafter is best for those who fear Allah; then will you not reason?

ayahs.ar: حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا اسۡتَيۡـَٔسَ الرُّسُلُ وَظَنُّوۡ٘ا اَنَّهُمۡ قَدۡ كُذِبُوۡا جَآءَهُمۡ نَصۡرُنَاۙ فَنُجِّيَ مَنۡ نَّشَآءُؕ وَلَا يُرَدُّ بَاۡسُنَا عَنِ الۡقَوۡمِ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Hattaaa izas tai'asar Rusulu wa zannooo annahum qad kuziboo jaaa'ahum nas runaa fanujjiya man nashaaa'u wa laa yuraddu baasunna 'anil qawmil mujrimeen
ayahs.en: [They continued] until, when the messengers despaired and were certain that they had been denied, there came to them Our victory, and whoever We willed was saved. And Our punishment cannot be repelled from the people who are criminals.

ayahs.ar: لَقَدۡ كَانَ فِيۡ قَصَصِهِمۡ عِبۡرَةٌ لِّاُولِي الۡاَلۡبَابِؕ مَا كَانَ حَدِيۡثًا يُّفۡتَرٰي وَلٰكِنۡ تَصۡدِيۡقَ الَّذِيۡ بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهِ وَتَفۡصِيۡلَ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ وَّهُدًي وَّرَحۡمَةً لِّقَوۡمٍ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Laqad kaana fee qasasihim 'ibratul li ulil albaa; maa kaana hadeesany yuftaraa wa laakin tasdeeqal lazee baina yadihi wa tafseela kulli shai'inw wa hudanw wa rahmatal liqawminy yu'minoon
ayahs.en: There was certainly in their stories a lesson for those of understanding. Never was the Qur'an a narration invented, but a confirmation of what was before it and a detailed explanation of all things and guidance and mercy for a people who believe.
